About Snowprint Studios

Do you enjoy building backend systems in a live game where things move quickly and priorities can change from one day to the next?

As a Senior Server Developer at Snowprint, you’ll work on the backend systems that power Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. You’ll build new features, improve existing systems, and take ownership of parts of the infrastructure that keep the game running. With a live game, there is always something new to solve, and your work can go from idea to player-facing feature quickly.

You’ll join a small, experienced backend team where you’ll have a high level of responsibility and autonomy. One day you might be working on a new feature, the next on infrastructure, troubleshooting a live issue, or responding to a new requirement from the team. We work in an environment where things change regularly, so being able to adapt, make decisions, and keep moving is an important part of the role.

At Snowprint, we believe that kindness, curiosity, collaboration, and taking ownership are key to making great games. We care about the player experience and work closely across disciplines to build and improve our games.

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment — while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.

Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.

For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.

Good to know

What you’ll be doing

You’ll develop backend features for Tacticus and take ownership of parts of the backend systems, from planning and technical design through development, testing, and live operations. You’ll work on new features as well as improving and evolving existing systems to support the needs of a growing live game.

A significant part of the role will be working with our cloud infrastructure. You’ll help own and improve our cloud environment, working with AWS and infrastructure-as-code to build, maintain, and evolve the systems running the game. You’ll collaborate with our security and compliance specialists and help keep our development and live environments running smoothly.

You’ll work closely with your fellow developers, designers, and other disciplines to shape technical solutions and solve problems as they arise. You’ll participate in playtests, investigate issues in both development and live environments, and take part in on-call work.

The pace can be high and priorities can change quickly. You’ll need to be comfortable moving between feature development, infrastructure, troubleshooting, and other technical challenges as the needs of the game evolve.

Is this you?

• You’re an experienced backend developer with a strong professional background in building and operating live services. Experience from gaming is highly relevant, particularly from live games or LiveOps environments.

• You’re fluent in Java and/or Kotlin and comfortable designing and building robust backend systems. You know how to work in an environment where you need to make decisions, move quickly, and evolve existing systems as requirements change.

• You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS, and are comfortable owning and maintaining cloud environments using infrastructure-as-code.

• You’re comfortable with the realities of live development, including troubleshooting production issues, participating in on-call work, and balancing immediate problems with longer-term improvements.

• You’re self-directed and collaborative. You communicate clearly, can explain the reasoning behind your technical decisions, and are comfortable working with people from different disciplines. You enjoy learning, solving new problems, and improving both the systems you work on and how the team works.

Where you’ll work

Our Berlin studio is located in Mitte, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

For this position we prefer you to already be located in Berlin, but are open to applicants already located within the EU.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer – AI-Native Product & Agents
Fully remote · Germany preferred, not required · Full-time · Equity options possible

About Acquirepad
Acquirepad is the AI-native operating system for institutional commercial real estate investors in the DACH region.
Our platform brings deal management, underwriting and DCF valuation, portfolio and asset management, market intelligence and data management together in one place. AI agents already work across all of it: reading documents, structuring data, running analyses and automating workflows that used to take investment teams days.
We're a small, senior team building a complex B2B product for demanding institutional customers. We ship continuously, and we build with AI every day, not just into the product.

The Role
We're looking for a senior product engineer who can own features end to end, from data model and backend through agent logic to a polished interface. You'll work directly with the founders and our engineers, and you'll have real influence on the product and the architecture.

What You'll Do
• Build AI agents and workflows: design and ship agentic systems, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, evaluation harnesses, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows.
• Own the backend: build APIs, services and data pipelines in Python and PostgreSQL that hold up under real institutional workloads.
• Own data management: ingest, clean, structure and connect fragmented real estate data from documents, spreadsheets, third-party sources and customer systems.
• Build great interfaces: fast, intuitive React and TypeScript screens for complex, data-heavy enterprise workflows.
• Ship end to end: take features from the first customer conversation to production, then keep improving them.
• Raise engineering velocity: push AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, agents in CI), reusable components, automated testing and pragmatic architecture.
• Own production quality: reliability, performance, security, permissions and auditability.

What We're Looking For
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production-grade web applications you have shipped.
• Strong backend engineering: Python, API design, PostgreSQL, data modeling and data pipelines.
• Strong frontend engineering: React, TypeScript and modern component architecture, with a real eye for UX.
• Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: tool calling, agents, RAG, structured outputs, prompt and context engineering.
• Experience building agent harnesses, workflow orchestration and evaluation, or a strong desire to go deep on it.
• AI-native way of working: you use Claude Code, Cursor or similar tools every day and keep improving how you build.
• Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing and production deployments.
• High agency and ownership: you spot problems, propose solutions and deliver without waiting for fully specified tickets.
• Product mindset: you think in customer value, not just tickets and code.
• Experience in an early-stage or high-growth startup.
• Excellent communication skills and fluent English (required).

Strong Plus
• Fluent German.
• Experience with MCP, multi-agent systems or LLM evaluation frameworks.
• Document processing and data extraction (PDFs, spreadsheets, unstructured data).
• AWS, Docker, ECS/Fargate, Redis, Elasticsearch or infrastructure as code.
• Enterprise SaaS: integrations, permissions, audit trails and data security.
• Real estate, finance, investment management or other data-intensive industries.
• Zero-to-one experience: building products from scratch and scaling them.

What We Offer
• Fully remote. Based in Germany is preferred, but not required.
• Competitive, market-rate salary.
• Equity options possible.
• Real ownership of product, architecture and engineering decisions.
• Direct work with the founders and our institutional customers.
• Production AI systems at the core of the product, not as a side feature.
• Small team, short feedback loops, minimal bureaucracy.

What We Are Not Looking For
A pure frontend developer, an enterprise developer who waits for fully specified tickets, or an AI researcher without experience shipping production software.

Interested?
Apply with your CV, LinkedIn or GitHub, and tell us about the most interesting AI agent, workflow or product you've built.

Introduction

Your Mission:

Join the Pinnacle of Satellite Technology Advancement in Germany!

Reflex Aerospace is at the forefront of propelling high-performance satellite technology to new heights within the German aerospace landscape.

As part of Reflex Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the trajectory of the space industry's future. This is an opportunity to contribute your expertise and enthusiasm to a team that stands for innovation and excellence.

About us

Reflex Aerospace, a NewSpace startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Munich and Berlin, has been leading the charge to provide advanced dual-use satellite technology at unparalleled speed. The company is leveraging the latest techniques to modernize payload-centric satellite development and production, achieving significantly faster delivery times and enhanced reliability. By applying algorithmic engineering and streamlined system design processes, Reflex accelerates the delivery of satellites enabling lightning-fast innovation for our customers.

Your tasks

As Software Engineer - Systems Modeling you will join the Architecture and Processes (A&P) team to develop the system infrastructure that enables the rapid development of satellite missions. You will work closely with all engineering teams to develop tools, digital models, and processes to enable our mission teams.

Your Background:

• You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering or a related field, or bring equivalent work experience.

• You have experience with MBSE, SysMLv2, and code-based systems modeling.

• You have strong Python skills and are experienced in architecture, testing, automation, databases, and API interfacing.

• You are proficient with Git, GitLab, and CI pipelines - you should be comfortable managing branches, handling merge requests, and troubleshooting CI issues independently.

• You are structured and process-oriented with a keen sense of simplicity and automation.

• You are a collaborative team player and communicate effortlessly with different stakeholders.

• Ideally, you already bring an understanding of satellite missions, system architectures, satellite subsystems and the satellite development lifecycle.

• Ideally, you have experience with UI design for data visualization, databases (PostgreSQL, InfluxDB), and Grafana.

What We Offer:

• Collaborate with a diverse multinational team crafting the next wave of cutting-edge satellites. Embark on this exciting journey with us from the outset, leaving your indelible mark on a dynamic company and playing a direct role in shaping the future of the space industry.

• Keep your energy levels high with company-sponsored memberships for Urban Sports Club as well a discount in the public transport.

• Access to Corporate Benefits - a website with many discounts for various brands.

• An annual training budget of 1.500€.

• We exclusively offer permanent employment contracts, reflecting our commitment to building long-term relationships and supporting sustainable career growth within our organization.

• A 20% contribution to your private pension plan.

• We provide a hybrid work model along with flexible working hours, empowering you as the owner of your time management.

Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation and a special company holiday on April 12th, celebrating the International Day of Human Space Flight and the spirit of exploration.

Join Reflex Aerospace and be a driving force in shaping the next era of space exploration! We look forward to your application.

About The Role

What if your years of software engineering experience could directly shape how AI writes code for millions of developers? We're looking for Software Engineers in Berlin to evaluate, rank, and refine AI-generated code — helping the next generation of coding assistants produce solutions that are correct, efficient, idiomatic, and production-ready.

Your deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and real-world engineering trade-offs is exactly what AI models need to get better. This isn't about writing boilerplate — it's about applying expert judgment to push the boundaries of what AI can do with code.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for experienced developers who want meaningful, high-impact work on their own schedule.

• Organization: Alignerr
• Type: Hourly Contract
• Location: Remote
• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Review and rank AI-generated code solutions across multiple programming languages and problem domains
• Evaluate code for correctness, efficiency, readability, maintainability, and adherence to best practices
• Identify bugs, anti-patterns, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI-generated outputs
• Write detailed, structured feedback explaining why one solution is better than another
• Refine and improve AI-generated code to meet production-level engineering standards
• Provide preference rankings that help AI models learn what "good code" actually looks like
• Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

• Software engineer with 3+ years of professional development experience
• Proficient in one or more major programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, Rust)
• Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity
• Deep understanding of software design principles, clean code practices, and engineering trade-offs
• Experienced with code review — you know how to assess quality and articulate why something works or doesn't
• Clear, concise written communicator who can explain technical decisions effectively in English
• Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision

Nice to Have

• Experience across multiple languages, frameworks, or tech stacks
• Background in systems design, distributed systems, or backend architecture
• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)
• Prior experience with code evaluation, technical mentoring, or open-source contribution
• Knowledge of security best practices and performance optimization
• Experience in competitive programming or technical interviewing

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
• Directly influence how AI coding assistants learn to write better software
• Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
• Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
• Leverage your hard-earned engineering expertise in a new, high-impact way
• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
• Join a global community of top-tier engineers shaping the future of AI-assisted development

Du bist auf der Suche nach neuen beruflichen Herausforderungen und möchtest zeitgleich etwas zu einer Fossilfreien Zukunft beitragen?
Unsere Aufgabe im Bereich Customer IT der Vattenfall IT ist es, digitale Lösungen und Produkte zu entwickeln und zu betreiben, die es unseren Geschäftseinheiten ermöglichen unser gemeinsames Ziel zu erreichen: Fossilfreies Leben innerhalb einer Generation!
Eine wesentliche Voraussetzung zur Erreichung dieses Ziels ist die Optimierung und Digitalisierung unserer Geschäftsprozesse. Die tägliche Arbeit unserer Spezialisten aus den Fachabteilungen im Zusammenspiel mit Kunden, Servicepartnern und Kollegen soll dadurch vereinfacht werden. Dabei gewonnene Freiräume können genutzt werden, um unserem übergeordneten Ziel mit innovativen Ideen und Produkten näher zu kommen.
Das Backend System von Vattenfall Sales Germany durchläuft eine Transition von einer monolithischen Architektur in eine cloud-native Microservice Architektur. In der Position als .NET Software Engineer (Backend) wirst Du zu dieser Transformation beitragen, indem Du .NET Applikationen auf unserer Azure Cloud Plattform aufbaust.
Du bist Teil eines agilen Teams, das in Berlin / Hamburg und auch remote ansässig ist und fokussierst Dich in diesem Kontext auf betriebsnahe Tätigkeiten und Herausforderungen im Umfeld von AWS und Microsoft Azure.
Was wirst Du tun?
Als .NET Software Engineer (Backend) wirst Du zentrale Backend-Komponenten für Vattenfall Sales Germany entwickeln. Unsere Systeme verarbeiten mehrere Millionen Aufrufe pro Tag – Du spielst eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Umsetzung leistungsfähiger, cloud-nativer Anwendungen. Dabei bringst Du dein Know-how in der .NET-Entwicklung und im Umgang mit Azure-Services ein, um robuste und skalierbare Lösungen zu schaffen.
Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Entwicklung moderner .NET-Backend-Anwendungen in einer cloud-nativen Architektur
• Nutzung von Azure-Services zur Umsetzung skalierbarer und wartbarer Lösungen
• Aufbau und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines mit Azure DevOps
• Aktive Mitgestaltung architektonischer Entscheidungen im Bereich Software- und Lösungsarchitektur
• Verantwortung für den operativen Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der entwickelten Systeme
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Business zur Analyse und Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen
Location

Berlin oder Hamburg

Qualifikationen

Wer bist Du?

Als unser:e neue:r .NET Software Engineer (Backend) bringst Du fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung moderner Backend-Anwendungen mit – idealerweise in cloudbasierten Umgebungen. Du bewegst Dich sicher im .NET-Ökosystem und hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis für angrenzende Themen wie Infrastruktur, CI/CD und Observability.

Du arbeitest gern an sauberen, wartbaren Architekturen und verstehst die Bedeutung von Automatisierung, Unit Tests und Integration Tests. Microservices, Event-getriebene Kommunikation oder die 12-Factor-Prinzipien sind für Dich keine Theorie – Du setzt sie im Alltag ganz praktisch um.
Dazu bringst Du mit:
• Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit .NET
• Grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit verschiedenen Azure-Cloud-Services wie Key Vaults, App Configurations oder der Microsoft Graph API
• Erfahrung im Einsatz von Container-Technologien wie Docker, Docker Compose und Helm
• Praxiserfahrung mit Hosting-Services wie Kubernetes oder Azure App Service
• Kenntnisse in Infrastructure-as-Code-Tools wie Terraform oder Bicep
• Wissen im Bereich von Database und Storage Technologien wie PostgreSQL, Oracle oder Azure Storage
• Vertrautheit mit CI/CD-Lösungen wie ArgoCD, Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions
• Erfahrung mit Observability-Tools wie Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus oder Splunk
• Kenntnisse in der Implementierung automatisierter Tests mit Tools wie xUnit oder Testcontainers
• Verständnis gängiger Architekturprinzipien wie den 12-Factor-App-Prinzipien, Microservices, Event-driven Design oder CQRS
• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Und keine Sorge: Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt auf dieser Liste perfekt abdecken. Wenn Du Dich in der Rolle wiedererkennst und glaubst, dass Du gut zu uns passt, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung – ganz unabhängig vom Häkchen hinter jedem Stichpunkt.

Zusätzliche Informationen

Was wir bieten
Arbeiten bei Vattenfall ist mehr als „nur“ ein interessanter Job in einem ergebnisorientierten Unternehmen. Du wirst Teil eines spannenden, innovativen und internationalen Arbeitsumfeldes, welches unsere Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten kann. Wir wollen die Besten in dem sein, was wir tun. Wir bieten dir eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung sowie Möglichkeiten für Schulungen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Wir möchten unseren Mitarbeiter:innen eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen Beruf und Familie ermöglichen. Aus diesem Grund bieten wir flexible Optionen an, wie die Möglichkeit, im Home Office zu arbeiten.
Weitere Informationen
Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung in deutscher Sprache bis spätestens zum 15.11.2026. Wir bitten Dich, Bewerbungen ausschließlich über unsere Website einzureichen, da wir nicht garantieren können, dass wir Bewerbungen bearbeiten, die nicht über unsere Website eingehen.
Wenn Du inhaltliche Fragen zur Stelle hast, dann kannst Du Dich gerne an den einstellenden [person:1] unter [email:1] wenden. Wenn Du mehr zum Bewerbungsprozess wissen möchtest, kannst Du Dich gerne an [person:2] unter [email:2] wenden.
Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt dazu beiträgt, unser Unternehmen leistungsfähiger und attraktiver zu machen. Bewerbungen zum Beispiel von Personen jeglichen Alters, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, ethnisch-kulturellen Hintergrunds sind herzlich willkommen. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher fachlicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.
Die Sicherheit von Vattenfall und seinen Beschäftigten ist von grundlegender Bedeutung. Aus diesem Grund ist ein Pre-Employment Screening Teil des Rekrutierungsprozesses. Der Umfang der Überprüfung variiert je nach Funktion und Einsatzbereich. Das Screening wird von einem Drittanbieter, DISA, durchgeführt.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Wir bei Vattenfall arbeiten an der Energiewende und brauchen hierfür Menschen, die sich mit ganzer Kraft für unsere Kund:innen und eine nachhaltige Gesellschaft engagieren – Menschen wie Sie. Wir sind ein führendes Energieunternehmen in Europa mit rund 21.000 Mitarbeitenden. Seit mehr als 100 Jahren elektrifizieren wir Industrien, versorgen Menschen mit Energie und modernisieren unseren Lebensstil durch Innovation und Zusammenarbeit.

About this role
Why Mozilla?
• Design, build and implement security and hardening features for enterprise users: Design, implement, test, and ship cutting-edge security features that strengthen Firefox’s security posture.

• AI-Coding-Stack: Du baust unseren internen Stack für agentische Softwareentwicklung von Grund auf – Auswahl, Konfiguration und Betrieb der Coding-Agent-Umgebung, bewusst modell- und anbieterneutral.
• Testautomatisierung & Dokumentation: Du schließt unsere größten technischen Lücken: automatisierte Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests sowie agententaugliche technische Dokumentation im Repository.
• Quality Gates: Du etablierst automatisierte Code-Reviews als festen Bestandteil unserer CI/CD-Pipeline und baust eine synthetische Test-Daten-Factory auf, die den gesamten Workflow aus dem DSGVO-Scope hält.
• Aktive Entwicklung: Du entwickelst mit – rund die Hälfte Deiner Zeit baust Du reale Features über genau die Pipeline, die Du aufsetzt. Der Mix ist wellenförmig: Phasen intensiver Stack-Arbeit wechseln mit Phasen aktiver Entwicklung.
• Governance: Du definierst die verbindlichen KI-Vorgaben für unsere externen Entwicklungsdienstleister und verantwortest das interne Quality Gate. Dabei führst Du kein Team – gefragt ist fachliche Autorität, keine disziplinarische.
• Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest einen internen Kollegen ein, der die Rolle gemeinsam mit Dir trägt und den Stack langfristig mitverantwortet.
Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast rund 7-10 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung auf Senior- oder Lead-Niveau hinter Dir, mit Architekturverantwortung. Java und Spring Boot im Backend, idealerweise Angular im Frontend.
• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C1) und fließend Englisch und hast einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland.
• Microservices, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL und CI/CD sind für Dich Alltag. Testautomatisierung hast Du nicht nur genutzt, sondern aufgebaut.
• Du arbeitest täglich mit agentischen Coding-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Codex und orchestrierst mehrere Agenten parallel. Jahreszahlen erwarten wir hier ausdrücklich nicht – diese Arbeitsweise gibt es erst seit Ende 2025.
• Du pflegst eigene Kontext-Dateien, Skills und System-Prompts und kannst sie uns zeigen. Du hast eine belastbare Antwort darauf, wie Du agentengenerierten Code verifizierst.
• Du kannst begründen, warum Du welches Werkzeug einsetzt – statt dem jeweils neuesten Trend zu folgen.
• Du verstehst Business, nicht nur Technik, und kannst gegenüber externen Dienstleistern Standards setzen und durchsetzen.
• Wünschenswerte Kenntnisse: Idealerweise hast Du bereits eine eigene agentische Entwicklungs-Pipeline aufgebaut – inklusive Review und Testing, beruflich oder privat. Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern sowie in der Steuerung externer Entwicklungsdienstleister ist von Vorteil.

jobs.job_description:
RoboService GmbH brings humanoid robots to industrial facilities. We program robotics applications that work on the manufacturing lines of European manufacturing companies.
Your first months at RoboService GmbH
You will be working hands on with humanoid robots. As a senior robotics engineer, your task is to architect and implement robotics applications for our clients. You will work in a team among the best robotic talents. You will be able to take on responsibility for the full lifecycle of a robotics application, to write and gate the code that the team ships to production.
What you bring
Extensive experience in robotics and software engineering
Excitement for humanoid robots and a passion for automation
Commitment to building reliable systems for industrial applications.
Qualifications matching the profile description below
Stock Options: You will be compensated in salary and generous stock options -- we want you to feel like an integral part of the success and growth of the company
Berlin based: We’re an in-person team and we work out of our office in downtown Berlin. If you’re not in Berlin, we would like to help you move here.
Access to Cutting Edge Tech: Work daily on the latest software and hardware that will shape our future.
Impact: Work in real projects with manufacturers to bring robots onto manufacturing floors.
Startup Environment: We are a fast-moving startup with high growth ambitions.
Team of Experts: We are a team of experts where every voice matters. Work with professionals that are leading their field.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on work experience in robotics; 5+ years of professional experience
Core Skills: Python and agentic coding
Robotics Stack: ROS2, including navigation, manipulation, and driver integration.
Simulation: Proven experience with physics-based simulators, specifically NVIDIA Isaac Sim or similar (Gazebo, MuJoCo).
Pioneering: Experience debugging hardware/software interfaces on non-standard platforms.
Full working proficiency in English
Your path forward
You will work on the hottest topics in robotics and software.
